CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Green, orange, and purple
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   B. Practise Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

3. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

4. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.

5. Best practice when working on Rounders: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Rounders.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rounders.
   C. Practise Rounders with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rounders.

6. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Melody.

7. Best practice when working on Wind Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Wind Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Wind Musical Instruments.
   C. Practise Wind Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Wind Musical Instruments.

8. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Mosaic.
   B. Practise Painting and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Mosaic.
   D. Damage equipment used for Painting and Mosaic.

9. Best practice when working on Football: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Football.
   B. Practise Football with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Football.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Football.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the volume

11. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

12. Best practice when working on Puppetry: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Puppetry.
   B. Practise Puppetry with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Puppetry.
   D. Damage equipment used for Puppetry.

13. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

14. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

15. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   D. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Football and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Mosaic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Rounders and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
